import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { getBackendTianshuContent, type TianshuStage } from '@src/api/bot/tianshu-content';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  if (!e.MessageText.match(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?天书$/)) {
    return;
  }

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();
  let content;

  try {
    content = await getBackendTianshuContent(bid);
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('查询天书失败:', error);
    md.addText('天书暂时不可用，请稍后重试。');
    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '天书', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  md.addText(content.intro);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addNewline();

  const addStage = (stage: TianshuStage, current: boolean) => {
    md.addBold(`${current ? '当前大境界' : '下一大境界'}：${stage.stageName}`);
    md.addNewline();
    if (stage.unlocks.length === 0) {
      md.addText('暂无明确的新功能解锁。');
      md.addNewline();
    }
    for (const item of stage.unlocks) {
      md.addText(`${current ? (item.unlocked ? '已开放' : '待开放') + ' · ' : ''}${item.realm}`);
      md.addNewline();
      for (const feature of item.features) {
        md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`- ${feature}`));
      }
    }
    md.addNewline();
  };

  if (content.currentStage || content.nextStage) {
    md.addText(content.currentStage ? `当前境界：${content.currentStage.realmName ?? content.currentStage.stageName}` : '当前暂无境界资料。');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();

    if (content.currentStage) {
      addStage(content.currentStage, true);
    }
    if (content.nextStage) {
      addStage(content.nextStage, false);
    } else {
      md.addText('暂无下一大境界资料。');
    }
  } else {
    // During rollout, older backends still return the original full catalogue.
    for (const item of content.realmUnlocks) {
      md.addBold(item.realm);
      md.addNewline();

      for (const feature of item.features) {
        md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`- ${feature}`));
      }

      md.addNewline();
    }

    md.addBold('附加条件');
    md.addNewline();
    for (const note of content.notes) {
      md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${note}`));
    }
  }

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '天书',
      content: md
    })
  );
});
